protocol: Initialized isolated persistent processes; normal NumPy/estimator imports and configuration are recorded separately. No model or query prewarm. Every request constructs and fits a new estimator, then times its first query and separately its second query. Public NumPy results establish completion; no harness MLX import/device probe/synchronization runs before the first query. Both outputs are audited after both timers. All requested rounds (default 30), including first model per fixture and first model in worker, remain visible. Earlier models may initialize runtime/compiler caches. This is model-first-use in an initialized process, not fresh-process or machine-cold latency. Five-worker Williams order has a complete balanced 10-round block, repeated three times by default. Any incomplete final block is also retained. No classification/regression operations are added here; the separate full broad and preservation control panels retain those operations and fixtures.

reference.source_state: Final warmed Digits and cold-latency fix: fused exact integer selector, native bit-safe feature ranges, lazy GPU initialization, normal CPU dependency import, and unknown-device pickle preservation
reference.freeze_format: sorted ZIP_STORED; fixed 1980 timestamp; regular files mode 0644

reference_runtime.restore_policy: Manual restoration requires matching CPython ABI, extension suffix, arm64 architecture and compatible macOS runtime. Otherwise rebuild from the source archive and included build files. Source-only portable fallback is supported but is not the measured native configuration.
